title: The Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-10-13
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a brief but fiery 1968 performance, highlighted by a scorching "The Eleven" jam.
ai_review.review: This Miller‑sourced soundboard tape delivers a clear and well‑balanced listening experience despite its age. The show may be short, but the energy is high, with a standout William Tell → The Eleven sequence that fans rave about. Overall the recording and performance are both praised by reviewers.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 4–5 stars, praising both the musical intensity (especially The Eleven) and the quality of the Miller soundboard tape; no significant criticisms were noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch‑corrected Miller soundboard tape; clear enough for listeners, with minor vintage limitations but generally crisp and balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A short set that builds momentum early, featuring a powerful jam from William Tell into The Eleven; overall high‑energy performance despite limited length.
